title: API key management with hashing

requirements.text: Keys are generated from a CSPRNG with enough entropy and an identifiable, non-secret prefix
The full key is shown once at creation; only a hash (or HMAC) of it is stored
Requests are authenticated by looking up the prefix and comparing the hash in constant time
Each key belongs to one tenant and carries scopes; a request is limited to them
Revoked or expired keys are rejected immediately on the next request
Only authorized members can create, list or revoke keys, and cannot mint a key with more access than they hold
Creation, revocation and last-used time are recorded without logging the secret

notes: No Genlib package covers API key management. Building blocks: capability:recovery-codes hashes and finds one-time codes; module:webhook-verification has a constant-time byte comparison; module:rbac can check scopes.
